name: mpocock
description: Compact a conversation into a handoff document another agent can pick the work up from.

interface.longDescription: Writes down what a session established, what it decided, and what is still open, in a form a fresh agent reads instead of the transcript. Use it before context runs out, before handing a long pipeline to a successor, or when another session continues the work.
defaultPrompt: Write a handoff document for this session.
Compact what we have done so another agent can continue.
